source_text: Si per commixtionem parentum, damna nuptias professione, quas argumentatione condemnas; et deme nobis laborem, quo te convicimus esse Manichaeum. Sin autem tu non id audes dicere, ac ratione contumax concumbentibus inclinaris, ut per argumentorum hactenus inaudita portenta, dicas libidinem diabolicam esse, eamque in sensu coeuntium positam, ad voluptatem parentum, ad reatum pertinere nascentium; tuam quidem amentiam et turpitudinem prodis; sed precor ne tibi tantum arroges, ut putes nobis liberum non esse cum honore Dei nascentium innocentiam contueri; cum tibi liceat et libeat, cum accusatione Dei a reatu, quem dicis libidinis, libidinantium membra purgare.
pass_a_gloss: If through the mingling of the parents, damn marriages by profession, which you condemn by argumentation; and take from us the labor by which we convict you to be a Manichaean. But if you do not dare to say that, and, stubborn in reason, you bow to those lying together, so that, through portents of arguments unheard of until now, you say that lust is diabolical, and that it, placed in the sense of those coupling, belongs to the pleasure of the parents, to the reatus of those being born; you indeed betray your own madness and turpitude; but I pray that you not arrogate so much to yourself as to think that it is not free for us to look upon the innocence of those being born with the honor of God; when it is allowed to you and it pleases you, with an accusation of God, to purge from the reatus, which you call of lust, the members of those lusting.

pass_b_english: If it comes through the parents’ union, openly condemn the marriage your argument condemns, and spare us the work of proving you a Manichaean. But if you do not dare say this, and, defiant of reason, bow to those having intercourse, you produce unheard-of monstrosities of argument. You say that lust is diabolical and, although located in the feelings of those coupling, provides the parents’ pleasure but the newborn children’s guilt. You certainly expose your own madness and shamefulness. But please do not presume so far as to think we are not free to defend newborn children’s innocence while honoring God, when you are permitted—and pleased—to accuse God while clearing the lustful people’s own bodies of what you call lust’s guilt.

choices.why: Julian refuses to make marital desire a nature-sin substance planted by the devil.
Parents insofar as parents are not guilty; keep the forensic 'in quantum parentes sunt'.
